user.title: CalDAV edit
user.description: Adds actions that change and delete events in your CalDAV calendars. It uses the CalDAV integration's existing login.

abort.single_instance_allowed: CalDAV edit is already set up.

update_event.name: Update event
update_event.description: Changes one event, found by its title and the day it is on. Copies of the event in several of the given calendars are changed together. Repeating events are refused.

date.name: Day
date.description: The day the event is on now.

title.name: Title
title.description: The event's current title (part of it is enough).

new_start.name: New start
new_start.description: YYYY-MM-DD HH:MM, or YYYY-MM-DD for all day. Without a new end the event keeps its length.

delete_event.name: Delete event
delete_event.description: Deletes one event, found by its title and the day it is on, from every given calendar that has a copy. Repeating events are refused.

date.name: Day
date.description: The day the event is on.

title.name: Title
title.description: The event's title (part of it is enough).
